user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
It really is — 2 AM is deep into the night! But you covered a lot of ground: relative and parallel minors, harmonic and melodic variations, and you have six concrete versions of your motif to try at the piano.

Get some rest, and when you sit down to play tomorrow, start with the A natural minor and C harmonic minor versions. Those two will give you the clearest contrast between the soft natural minor sound and the dramatic leading-tone pull.

Sleep well, and come back anytime you want to keep developing the motif or dive into anything else!
